cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.19)
project(PocketSdkConsumer C)
find_package(Pocket CONFIG REQUIRED COMPONENTS runtime)
add_library(consumer_quickjs STATIC quickjs/quickjs.c quickjs/dtoa.c quickjs/libregexp.c quickjs/libunicode.c)
target_include_directories(consumer_quickjs PUBLIC quickjs)
target_compile_definitions(consumer_quickjs PRIVATE _GNU_SOURCE)
target_compile_features(consumer_quickjs PRIVATE c_std_11)
if(UNIX)
  target_link_libraries(consumer_quickjs PUBLIC m)
endif()
set(Pocket_QUICKJS_TARGET consumer_quickjs)
find_package(Pocket CONFIG REQUIRED COMPONENTS runtime guest_quickjs)
find_package(Pocket CONFIG REQUIRED COMPONENTS guest_quickjs)
get_target_property(_guest_links Pocket::guest_quickjs INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES)
list(LENGTH _guest_links _guest_link_count)
if(NOT _guest_link_count EQUAL 2)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Repeated find_package must retain runtime and one QuickJS dependency")
endif()
add_executable(consumer main.c)
target_compile_options(consumer PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Werror -UNDEBUG)
target_link_libraries(consumer PRIVATE Pocket::guest_quickjs)
